urn:eigenius:program:component_argument.urn:eigenius:runtime:source:
# D-DIFF (DRIVE): WRN is the top preferential dependency in MSI vs MSS,
# reproduced from public RNAi data via limma moderated-t (D53 6 wrapped-R / D56).
# Inputs (D53 4.3 multi-file join): [1] DRIVE DEMETER2 matrix (genes x cell-lines,
# columns are CCLE_IDs), [2] Supp Table 1 (CCLE_MSI labels).
drv <- .Call("r_eigon_materialized_path", eigenius_inputs[[1]])
s1p <- .Call("r_eigon_materialized_path", eigenius_inputs[[2]])
suppressMessages({ library(data.table); library(limma) })
dt  <- fread(drv); g <- dt[[1]]; M <- as.matrix(dt[, -1]); rownames(M) <- g
s1  <- fread(s1p)
msi <- s1$CCLE_MSI[match(colnames(M), s1$CCLE_ID)]
keep <- !is.na(msi) & msi %in% c("MSI", "MSS")
M <- M[, keep]; grp <- factor(msi[keep], levels = c("MSS", "MSI"))
M <- M[rowSums(!is.na(M)) >= 3, ]
# limma moderated-t: DRIVE is already features (genes) x samples (cell lines).
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(M, model.matrix(~ grp)))
tt  <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by = "none"); tt$gene <- rownames(tt)
neg <- tt[tt$logFC < 0, ]; neg <- neg[order(neg$P.Value), ]
w   <- which(grepl("^WRN \\(", neg$gene))[1]
q   <- neg$adj.P.Val[w]; rnk <- as.numeric(w)
b <- .Call("r_eigon_begin", "urn:eigenius:pub:wrn:dd_drive:result")
.Call("r_eigon_set_f64", b, "urn:eigenius:measurements:adj_p_value", q)
.Call("r_eigon_set_f64", b, "urn:eigenius:pub:wrn:differential_rank", rnk)
if (rnk == 1) {
  .Call("r_eigon_set_proposition", b,
        "urn:eigenius:benchmark:onco:TopDifferentialDependency", c("WRN", "DRIVE_MSI"))
}
.Call("r_eigon_finish", b)
